title: 第1083章 修猫修狗第1082章 法慧的谋划
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
“一只猫一只狗？哈哈！”
这些附属宗门的宗主没有来过月影宗后山，也从未见过大哈，更不可能见过霸肌。
他们的修为对大哈和霸肌来说根本不算什么，犹如米粒。
所以他们自然无法察觉大哈的真正修为。
霸肌这头饕餮就更不用说了。
“不对。”法慧和尚皱起眉头，心头一紧：“这黑猫没见过，但……这看起来傻不拉几的大狗怎么有点眼熟？”
“傻不拉几？”大哈气笑了，狗嘴一张，唾沫星子乱飞:“你才傻不拉几，你要死了你知道不？”
“哈哈哈哈，他说我们要死了！”
当即就有同行的修士哈哈大笑。
“法慧大师，这月影宗的畜生真搞笑！一只小小狗妖居然说我们要死了？”
“真是狂妄！洒家倒是很久没有吃狗肉了，今日正好剥了这条老狗打打牙祭！”
周围修士的议论声不绝于耳。
但法慧和尚的脸色却是越来越沉。
他看到大哈脖颈上的沉金锁，那是月影宗护宗妖兽佩戴的信物。
法大海成佛之前跟他提及过。
如果在月影宗附近遇到一条戴金锁的狗，哪怕看起来蠢蠢的也不要去招惹，对方可能是隐藏修为的超级大妖。
当时他没有把这些话当回事，因为那时候他对月影宗只有崇拜和恐惧，哪里有颠覆月影宗的野心？
可随着越发了解月影宗，他就越发清楚月影宗有着怎样庞大的资源。
而月影宗给予他们这些附属宗门看似丰厚的资源其实不过是九牛一毛，连口汤都算不上。
“诸位——”

法慧心头一紧，忙一步退到众人身后，刚要开口警示。
便在此时，大哈动了。
“吼——！”
一声低沉的犬吠炸响，不再是先前懒洋洋的调子，反倒像古神钟鸣，震得众人神魂发麻。
只见原本憨态可掬的黑狗身形暴涨，黑亮的皮毛泛起层层月华与日辉交织的金芒。
犬首愈发威严锋锐，爪牙泛着寒芒，身后隐隐浮现日月并行的虚影。
滔天的妖圣威压铺天盖地倾泻而下，整座玄波峰的空气都仿佛凝固住。
日月天狗，月影宗护宗圣兽。
以前的大哈可没有这种实力。
奈何月影宗后山就是天精玉髓矿藏之地，灵气浓郁到都化成溪流了。
灵犀谷又在上面种了很多灵草，大哈闲着没事就喝点儿灵液，吃点儿灵草。
偶尔还会被陈怀安和李清然强化一下。
那些战令月卡白送的各种丹药，有些就直接扔给大哈了。
于是，便有了今日的妖圣之威。
毕竟身为护宗兽没点儿实力怎么行？
陈怀安是不会允许一只吉祥物做护宗兽的。
“扑通、扑通
——”
几名修为稍弱的宗主承受不住这股威压，膝盖一软便跪倒在地，浑身抖如筛糠，连抬头的勇气都没有。
剩下的人也面色惨白，牙关打颤，方才的嚣张气焰荡然无存。

“哎呀……这……
这是月影宗护宗兽啊……”
法慧和尚面无血色，声音发颤，后半句话像是从牙缝里挤出来的。
content_en:
"A cat and a dog? Haha!"
The sect leaders of these affiliated sects have never been to the back mountain of Yueying Sect, and they have never seen Daha, let alone Ba Ji.
Their cultivation is nothing to Daha and Baji, like grains of rice.
So naturally they couldn't detect Daha's true cultivation level.
Not to mention the gluttonous one named Ba Ji.
"That's wrong." Monk Fahui frowned, and his heart tightened: "I've never seen this black cat before, but...why does this silly-looking big dog look familiar?"
"How stupid are you?" Daha laughed angrily, opened his mouth, and spittle flew everywhere: "You are so stupid, you are going to die, do you know?"
"Hahahaha, he said we were going to die!"
Immediately some fellow monks laughed.
"Master Fahui, these beasts from the Moon Shadow Sect are so funny! A little little puppy demon actually said that we are going to die?"
"How arrogant! The Sa family hasn't eaten dog meat for a long time, and today I just happened to skin this old dog for a tooth-beating ceremony!"
The monks around were talking endlessly.
But Monk Fahui's face became darker and darker.
He saw the golden lock on Daha's neck, which was a token worn by the monster protecting the sect of the Moon Shadow Sect.
Fa Dahai mentioned it to him before he became a Buddha.
If you encounter a dog wearing a golden lock near the Moon Shadow Sect, don't mess with it even if it looks stupid. The dog may be a super demon with hidden cultivation.
He didn't take these words seriously at that time, because at that time he only had admiration and fear for the Moon Shadow Sect. How could he have the ambition to subvert the Moon Shadow Sect?
But as he learned more about the Moon Shadow Sect, he became more aware of the huge resources the Moon Shadow Sect had.
The seemingly rich resources that the Moon Shadow Sect gave to these affiliated sects were actually just a drop in the bucket, not even soup.
"Everyone——"
Fa Hui's heart tightened, and she hurriedly stepped back behind everyone, just as she was about to speak out a warning.
At this moment, Daha moved.
"Ho--!"
There was a low barking sound, no longer the lazy tone before, but like the ringing of an ancient god's bell, which made everyone's souls numb.
I saw the originally innocent black dog's figure skyrocketing, and its shiny black fur glowed with layers of golden light intertwined by the moonlight and the sun.
The dog's head became more majestic and sharp, its claws glowed with cold light, and the shadow of the sun and moon appeared faintly behind it.
The overwhelming pressure of the Demon Saint poured down from the sky, and the air in the entire Xuanbo Peak seemed to freeze.
Sun and Moon Tengu, the sacred beast protecting the Moon Shadow Sect.
The previous Daha did not have this kind of strength.
However, the mountain behind the Yueying Sect is the place where the Heavenly Essence Chalcedony is deposited, and the aura is so rich that it turns into a stream.
Lingxi Valley has planted a lot of spiritual grass on it. Daha drinks some spiritual liquid and eats some spiritual grass when he has nothing to do.
Occasionally, he will be strengthened by Chen Huaian and Li Qingran.
Some of the various elixirs given away for free by the monthly battle card were thrown directly to Daha.
As a result, the power of the Demon Saint emerged today.
After all, as a protector beast, what can you do if you don’t have any strength?
Chen Huaian would not allow a mascot to be a guardian beast.
"Thump, thump
——”
Several sect leaders with weaker cultivation levels could not bear the pressure. Their knees weakened and they fell to the ground. Their whole bodies were shaking like chaff, and they did not even have the courage to raise their heads.
The remaining people's faces were pale, their teeth were chattering, and the arrogance they had just now was gone.
"Oh...this...
This is the guardian beast of the Moon Shadow Sect..."
Monk Fahui's face was pale, his voice was trembling, and the second half of his words seemed to be squeezed out from between his teeth.
